tei:div.tei:p: "$ (1na1) ༄༅// rgyal sras gzhon nu pad+ma dkar po'i rtogs brjod do//

(1ba2)༄༅// rgya chen yon tan tshogs dang rtag tu 'dris// byams dang snying rje chen po'i dbang du song*// gzhan la phan pa thams cad bsgrub brtson pa'i/ 'gro ba'i gnyen bshes bzang po bsngags par 'os// skal bzang rna ba mdzes pa'i rgyan// snyan ngag srad bu la brgyus pa// grags pa rgya che'i nor bu'i 'phreng*// yid la re ba'i 'bras bu ster// 'di ltar grags so// kha ba can gyi shar phyogs kong po'i yul ljongs/ rtswa ljang ser yid du mchis pas ni sa phyogs thams cad khebs// mdangs bkra ba sna tshogs pa'i me tog gis brgyan pa bzhin 'dug /de la 'dus pa'i bung ba gzhon nu glu len pa ni lang long du rgyu/ gzugs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i ri dgas mang po ni dogs pa med pas dul bar gnas/ ne tso dang*/ ri skegs dang*/ khu byugs dang*/ spu sdug cing mdzes pa'i bya sna tshogs pa 'jo sgeg ldan pa'i rol rtse dkyil rgyu bas phan tshun 'brel ba'i gtam bgyid/ kha dog bzang po yal ga dang lo ma rgyas pa 'bras bu phun sum tshogs shing*/ bsung bzang po'i ngad ldang ba'i 'khri shing sna tshogs pas gang bar byas/ smig ma dang*/ rkang 'thung gsar bu skyes pa sir bus bskyod pa dag shug glu len zhing bro gar byed/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu bo chen po lo hi ta bai ḍū r+ya zhun ma ltar sngo zhing dngas ma ni dal gyis 'bab/ lhung lhung zer zhing ri bo'i ngogs su rings par rgyug pa'i chu bran gyis dang bar byas/ dur pa dang*/ khrung khrung dang*/ dang pa dang*/ mdzes pa'i chu bya mang po ni khrus kyi ched du 'jug cing byi ru ltar dmar ba'i sor mos 'thor bar byed/ brag ri dang*/ nags tshal dang*/ sman ljongs sna tshogs pas yid ngoms pas med par byas pa/ lha'i dga' tshal bzhin yul bde ba/ lo legs pa/ skye bo mang pos gang ba/ (2na3)longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la spyod cing*/ kun dga' bskyed pa'i gtam dang glu gar gyis gang bar byas pa/

mtho ris kyi grong gi 'gran zlar 'os pa zhig yod do// de yang mchims yul dgon gyi grong na/ rdo rje gzhon nus byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags 'chang gi rigs/ jo sras klu'i dbang po dang*/ chos skyong sgrol ma zhes skal ba can gyi pha mar bsngags pa rang bzhin bzang zhing dge ba la brtson pa zhig go// byang sems dang snying rje shes rab kyi 'bras bu byams pas brlan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi mnyes gshin bzang po zhig gis mngal bzung bar byas so// de ma thag ma'i rmi lam du/ 'od zer 'bum phrag 'phro ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhig lto ba na zhugs pa rmis so// sad ma thag dngangs te grogs mo zhig la smras so// de nas zla ba rdzogs pa dang*/ thams cad 'dul ba'i lo/ sos ka'i dus tha ma lo tog snye ma'i khur gyis lci ba'i skabs kyi dus bzang po la btsas te/ tshod de nyid du ltas dge ba rab tu mang ste/ skye bo gti mug pas gang gi mthu yin pa mi shes so// chen po 'byor pa'i bran du gyur pas brel/ dman rnams brnyas pas sdug bsngal ra bar tshud/ bar ma'i rigs gtsang 'di ni rgyal bas bsngags/ dam pa'i rjes su 'breng phyir bdag gis bsten/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i sku byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba zhig dpag tshad gcig tsam nas yod sar mas thogs te grogs mang po dang bcas nas phyin te bskor ba bgying pa na/ phyag na pad+mo'i snying po 'bru drug pa gsal por gsum bzhi bsgrags pa der 'dus pa rnams kyi thos pas/ rab tu dang ba thob ste/ a bo ma ṇi ba zhes kun tu grags so// skabs de'i tshon tshod ni skyes nas zla ba phyed gnyis tsam mo/ (2ba4)rten du gyur pa'i bdud zhig kyang*/ nye logs su gang dang dus mnyam par skyes la/ rkang lag kun mtheb mo drug pa mi sdug pa'i mtshan thams cad dang ldan pa zhig go// gnod pa thams cad bzlog pa'i ched du ye shes kyi lha mo re ma ti phyi bzhin 'brang bas mas bu gcig pa bzhin du skyong ngo*// mi ma yin pa'i tshogs kyis mchod cing bkur stir byed pa la rang stobs kyis bsrung ba'i phyir rjes bzhin 'gro'o// ltas mkhan dang*/

de dag gis kyang tshul de gzhan la 'gro bar byed do// skye bo dge legs kyi mig ma rig pa'i ling tog gis bsgribs pa dag yon tan gyis dman pa'i bla ma skye bo dag grub par sems pa zhig yin mchis zhes gleng mod/ de lta'ang*/ gser bzang po thal bar sgros btags pas ci zhig la gzhan du 'gyur/ lo ngo gsum lon pa na rang gi sngon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/ yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu son pa/ 'brug pa rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po zhes snyan grags kyi ba dan dkar po srid mthar rkyong ba/ zhi dul des pa'i snying stobs kyis mdzes pa'i spong ba pa brgya phrag lnga tsam gyi 'khor dang bcas phebs pa mjal/ byin gyis brlabs pa chen po mdzad mod/ dus la ma bab pas re zhig btang snyoms mdzad do// na chung de nyid/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba la blo mi 'jug cing*/ dge ba la brtson/ sdig pa'i go skabs mi byed pas/ gzhan mi dge ba bgyid pa las nan tan gyis bzlog par byed do// de yang ne'u ldang rnams dang lhan cig ljon shing gi drung me tog gi tsha la dag tu rtsa ba na yang*/ sngon rabs kyi gtam 'ba' zhig gleng zhing*/ spro bar byed na gzhan du lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nyid kyi mngon par shes pas legs nyes gsod phor smra ba skye bo dag yid ches pas kun dri ba'i gnas byed do// dus tshod la bab pa na/ gang gi grags pas sa chen po'i khyod mtha' dag cig car du khengs pas/ skye ba snga ma'i slob bu (3na5)kun spangs shes rab rgya mtsho sgyu ma'i gar mkhan zhes grags pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de nyid brtags par phebs nas dpyad pas mgu bas/ lo dgu pa'i steng du sngon gyi gnas lho phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams su sleb bo// der sngon rabs gang gi nu bo gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ gang gi sras sa skyong chen po bstan 'dzin nor bu mched kyis legs par brtags shing dpyad pas nges shes thob pa dang*/

yongs 'dzin dam pa'i lung bstan bslu ba med pa'i bden tshig kyang phebs pas/ ring por ma lon par/ mi pho spre'u'i lo rgyal bas cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i dga' ba dang po la/ gdan seng ge'i khri chen por mngon par dbang bskur chos kyi rgyal srid skyong bar mnga' gsol ba na/ skabs gsum pa'i tshogs kyis kyang me tog gi char phab bo// sna lnga pa'i 'ja' gur yang phub bo// bsod nams zong gi thob pa'i legs byas ldan/ bsam gtan goms byas tshe rabs gsal por dran/ rang bzhin sdig 'joms dge la sbyor ba 'di/ na chung dus su bsgrubs pa'i tshul yin no// de nas gzung ste/ slob dpon shes rab go cha la yi ge'i phyi mo 'bri ba dang klog pa tshul bzhin du bslabs/ slob dpon chos grags bstan 'phel bar/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i lag le mtha' dag bslabs so// kun mkhyen bkras rnam pa la/ bde dgyes/ mgon po'i dbang*/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po sogs rjes su gnang ba mang po thob bo/ de nas gser 'phyang gi lo la gdan bteg /pho brang 'phying bar stag rtser/ skye ba 'di'i sngon ma'i skyed ma nor 'dzin dbang mo dang*/ yab sa skyong ba'i dbang po mjal/ sngon gyi gtam gyi mol mchid kyang bgyid nas gdan sa chen po 'brug gi gtsug lag khang chen por son no// bstan pa'i bdag po kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang por gtsug phud phul/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa */ nā ro ta pa'i rgyal (3ba6)tshab 'gyur med ngag dbang nor bu'i sder ming gnang*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang*/ phyag na rdo rje'i byin rlabs/ mahā ka la'i rjes su gnang ba/ tshe rta zung 'brel/ khrid chen brgyad/ rten 'brel gyi chos skor/ sgra bsgyur mar pa/ rgya ras pa/ rgyal dbang bka' 'bum rnams dang*/ rje btsun nyid kyi bka' 'bum rnams nyan no// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan tshad med pa'i mnga' bdag /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dpon rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por/

dkar brgyud gser 'phreng*/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ phag gru gling*/ seng ge dgu tshar gyi bka' 'bum rnams zhus so// slar lho phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams su/ kun spangs sgyu ma'i gar mkhan nam tsaṇ+ḍa li pa zhes spang rtogs kyi yon tan chen po mnga' ba gang la/ 'khor lo sdom pa mai tri pa'i lugs kyi snyan rgyud/ paṇa chen nags rin lugs kyi rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa/ bde mchog /phag mo/ mgon po'i yig sna/ man lung gu ru'i dus 'khor snyan rgyud/ lam zab bla sgrub/ rten 'brel/ ro snyoms chen mo/ dmar zhabs/ dmar zhabs yig sna bzhi/ sba bzhi/ gsang lam chung ba/ rdo rje tshig 'byed/ gser gyi yang zhun/ bde chen skor gsum/ bsre 'pho snyan rgyud/ lan tshwa chu bsgyur/ thabs lam brgya rtsa/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ brda rtsa rgyal dbang rjes mdzad pa sogs khrid kyi rim pa dang lung mang po thob bo// 'dzin pa chen po rje btsun yon tan ye shes kyi drung du/ bu lugs rje gong mas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang*/ bde mgo gyi dbang*/ gshed mar lha lnga'i dbang*/ gu ru drag po dmar po'i gtor dbang chung ba/ u tsa'i rjes gnang*/ dpal ldan lha mo dud gsol ma'i rjes gnang*/ rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang*/ de gnyis kyi gsang sgrub/ mgon po gri gug gi rjes gnang*/ bza' bdud kyi rjes gnang*/ lha mo shra ma ṇa'i sgrub thabs sogs mang du thos so// de nas gdan sa chen po (4na7)me tog mdangs 'phrog gam ra lung thel du sleb ste/ yongs 'dzin pa'i drung du lam zab bla ma bsgrub pa/ dge sbyor bdun pa/ 'brug skor gyi gdams ngag mtha' dag gi gnad kun thob par bgyis so// rtogs pa dang shes rab kyi glong rdol bar lung bstan no// zhing gzhan du gshegs gdong*/ nyi shu dgu'i dgongs kho bo'i lag pa nas bzung*/ sku mdun dang mahā kā la gnyis la bstan pa'i khur khyer ba bab po zhes gsung nan tan du mdzad pa dang*/

gnam gang gi snga dro/ steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru sku mdun nyid gyur cig ces smon lam gsung tha mar gyur pa yin zhing*/ sku'i snang ba ni gshegs nas kyang lan mang du ston par mdzad do// mdor na rje btsun 'di dang skye bo mang po nyid nas 'dris la/ yang dag pa'i lam ston pa'i slob dpon thog ma nyid nas yin no// de nas dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rnams bsgrubs te/ rje dbon rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug gi drung du bsre 'pho dang*/ phyag rgya chen po skor gsum dang*/ thub pa lnga dang*/ ro snyoms/ mgon po'i rgyud sgrub thabs/ phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bzhi rdzogs/ rgyud gsang ba bstan pa che chung gnyis/ sgrubs thabs/ bde mchog gi yig sna lhan skyes kyi dbang sgrub thabs/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs/ mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ sgrol dkar sogs kyi rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs/ rngog lugs kyi dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang dang*/ brtag gnyis/ gur/ sam+bhu ṭi/ 'grel pa rin po che'i rgyan 'dra thob ba/ zin bris chen mo phal cher bzung*/ rgyud ni shin tu byang ba yin no// bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud sogs mdor na bka' 'gyur ro cog gi lung yang rim gyis rdzogs pa yin la/ rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub shin tu tshang bar thob cing lag len dogs pa ni/ dge slong chos kyi legs pa la dpyad do// 'brug skor gyi zab gnad thams cad kyi lag len ni sngags 'chang chos kyi mgon po la (4ba8)bslab pa yin no// gdan sa rin po che thel nas/ slob dpon brag sle ba/ chos rgyal lhun grub par/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ tshe dpag med lha mangs grub rgyal ma nas brgyud pa/ dze tā ri'i lugs kyi lha dgu ma/ nā ro lugs lhan skyes lha lnga/ mgon po'i bum dbang bcu bzhi pa/ rjes gnang*/

tshe dbang nga ro dmar ma/ rkang gling ma la sogs dbang rjes gnang dang*/ rdog pa'i zab chos tshang ma/ bsnyen sgrub dang thel lugs/ zhwa dmar nag gi lugs la grags pa'i khrid/ 'bri gung dgongs gcig dang*/ sa skya pa'i dag ljon sogs dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang*/ bsdus pa'i rgyud/ dbang mdor bstan/ de'i 'grel chen nā ro zhabs kyis mdzad pa sogs mang du thob bo// de nas slob dpon nyang ram pa kun dga' chos dar bar/ tshad ma rnam 'grol/ rig gter/ rgyud bla ma/ phar phyin/ dbu ma/ sdom gsum/ mngon pa mdzod/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba dag bslabs shing sbyangs pas shes rab dang spobs pa'i mchog tu gyur/ blang dor brtag pa la mkhas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob bo// lo ts+tsha ba ngag dbang la re zhig ka lā pa'i mtshams sbyor lnga pa slob ma la phan pa'i steng nas gzhan la mi dman par song*/ gra bkra shis phug pa ba jo sras dpal mgon 'phrin las bar dgu zla/ byed sgrub kyi lnga bsdus/ chos la spyod pa dang nyin zhag la spyod pa'i gza' lnga/ zhag gsum rnam dbye/ tat+ka la'i dus sbyor/ gza' 'dzin/ gtan rtsis/ skal li'i sbyor tshul/ dhū ba yar log /rtsis gzhi spo tshul/ byed pa'i 'chad tshul/ rtsis mo phran dang bcas pa zla ba gcig la shes so// dri med gsal ba'i blo ni bdud rtsi'i 'od/ yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbus brjid lhun po dang*/ blang dor ji bzhin ston pa rgyal sras bzhin/ skye bar sbyangs pa'i bsod nams 'bras bu yin/ rang lo bcu bdun pa mdzes byed kyi lo la chos grwa chen po dpal 'khor bde chen du/ de nyid dang tshogs chos lung (5na9)pa'i mkhan po bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po kun dga' bkra shis rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos mkhan po mdzad/ las slob sde snod 'dzin pa dkon mchog rin chen pa/ gsang ston slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes/ grib tshad nyang ram pa/ grogs dan pa dge slong sangs rgyas lhun grub/

dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa chig rdzogs su nos/ ngag dbang kun dga' rnam rgyal nor bu dpal bzang por ming btags so// rdor dkar stan cig pa'i brtul zhugs shin tu dam pa la gnas/ dran shes bzhin bag yod pas spyad do// zhi dul des pa'i yon tan gyis 'jig rten gyi mchod 'os su gyur to/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i ming ni mi pham pad+ma dkar po phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'o// dam pa'i spyod pa legs par bslabs pa/ rang gi lus dang srog la mi lta bar gzhan gyi don 'ba' zhig byed pa/ dad pa dang brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pas byang chub kyi phyogs las mi g.yo ba/ kha nam tho ba phra mos kyang gos pa med do// 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bcas khur khyer bas/ skye dang skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten tshul khrims ni/ kha na mtho'i skyon bral rnam dag bsrungs/ de yang 'jig rten 'di'i bde skyid snyan grags dang che thabs gang la yang ma chags shing zhen sred bral bas/ dngos po thams cad la sgyu mas sprul par shes pa/ bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin la brtson pa/ mchod 'os la gus pa/ 'phongs shing mgon med pa/ yongs su skyong ba/ skye bo rnams la gdams ngag 'khrul pa med par ston/ bshad pa dang sgrub pas rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin par byed do// ring du 'byor yang nam zhig nyams nges pas/ 'jig rten bde ba rgud pa'i mtha' yin no// khyim ni nyes kun skye ba'i zhing yin la/ dge ba 'dam bu'i tshal 'joms glang chen po/ mtho ris dga' ba sngar bsags 'bras brlag la/ (5ba10)bag med spyad pas sdig pa mang por 'phel/ ngan song mi bzad gnod pas kun tu gtses/ dge legs sa bon bskrun pa'i go skabs bral/ dang por rab zhim phyi nas 'joms pas ni/ 'dod yon dug gi chu dang 'dra bar shes/

sbrang rtsi'i byed pas bung ba gzir ba ltar/ bsag bsrung brlag pa'i zug rngu nor gyis skyed/ phun tshogs 'byor ba ji snyed sdug bsngal te/ 'phongs nas las dma' ba'i mya ngan ldang*/ 'bangs kyi gnod pa thams cad khur yin zhing*/ yul 'khor skyong bral rgyal po'ang kun gyi g.yog /sdug bsngal me lce brgya phrag 'bar ba ni/ las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa'i khyim gang las/ bros te nyer bzhi'i tshal rab snying stobs kyis/ mdzes pa dag la su zhig bsten mi byed/ thar pa'i grong der 'dzeg pa dang*/ ngan 'gro'i dod du 'bab pa ni/ legs nyes spyod pa'i them skas te/ dal 'byor khang bzang 'di la brten/ 'jig rten mi gtsang lung bzhin dor ba dang*/ 'byor rnams phyag dar rtsa bzhin bskyur nas su/ dka' thub nags su rab tu byung byas te/ nyer zhi ri bo'i dogs su dal gyis 'gro/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan shes rab thab me dang smon lam gyi/ nor bus gang ba'i byang sems mdzod phye nas/ bdag gzhan kun gyi dbu la 'phongs cis mi sel/ rgyal ba rnams kyis nges par bstan pa'i lam/ bslu ba med pa'i rjes su mi 'breng na/ gson por gyur kyang shing nga 'dra ba yin/ shes ldan kun gyis tshul 'di bsam par rigs/ byang sems mtsho las skyes pa dang*/ byams dang snying rjes brlan gyur pa'i/ pad dkar dad pa'i nyi 'od kyis/ bskul nas rtogs brjod dri zhim spros/ rnal 'byor sangs rgyas dar pos nan can bskul ba la brten/ sgros ma btags par rang lo nyi shu rtsa gsum pa yan gyi ngag mdor byas te brjod pa 'di yang*/ pad+ma dkar po'i legs byas zil dngar gyi zegs ma'o/// /shu bhaṃ ma stu sarba dza ga taṃ/ maṅga laṃ/ chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched// par bzhengs glegs bu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni// chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
